channel.title: Klaviyo - What's New
channel.description: Latest Klaviyo product updates and releases (unofficial feed).

item.title: Easier setup for Customer Agent
item.description:
Easier setup for Customer Agent — Get your AI support agent live faster â Set tool permissions in Connectors to Always allow, Only in skills, or Blocked, and save custom skills for sensitive tasks like refunds.
(Published 2026-11-12)

item.title: A/B testing in In App Forms
item.description:
A/B testing in In App Forms — Find which in-app forms drive the most mobile engagement â Create and publish A/B tests from the forms editor, then choose a winner from a dedicated results report.
(Published 2026-11-12)

item.title: Discount Affinity (Preview)
item.description:
Discount Affinity (Preview) — Protect your margin by saving offers for deal seekers â Target campaigns and flows to Deal seekers, Mixed buyers, or Full-price buyers based on each profile's discount history.
(Published 2026-11-12)

item.title: Removing requirements from Auto-replies
item.description:
Removing requirements from Auto-replies — Reply right away without requiring contact info. Auto Replies no longer have to collect an email or phone number, so you can send a thank you message with a link and button as soon as someone uses your keyword.
(Published 2026-11-10)

item.title: Dictation in Composer
item.description:
Dictation in Composer — Now customers can talk to Composer. Dictation turns what they say into text in their message draft, so they can get their ideas into Composer faster.
(Published 2026-11-10)

item.title: Composer Mobile App
item.description:
Composer Mobile App — Meet Klaviyo's first mobile app, powered by Composer. Stay on top of performance, get notified when something needs attention, and keep your marketing moving from anywhere.
(Published 2026-11-10)

item.title: Version History for Universal Content
item.description:
Version History for Universal Content — Roll back a bad publish to shared headers and footers â Preview past versions of universal blocks or sections and restore one everywhere it's used.
(Published 2026-11-10)

item.title: Opt-out Anonymous Profiles
item.description:
Opt-out Anonymous Profiles — Reduce profile clutter and Advanced KDP costs from unidentified app users â Turn off anonymous profile creation for Klaviyo's mobile SDKs in Settings > Data.
(Published 2026-11-10)

item.title: Instagram Live Auto-reply
item.description:
Instagram Live Auto-reply — Turn live viewers into conversations. Pick a keyword, and anyone who comments it during your Instagram Live gets your DM automatically.
(Published 2026-11-10)

item.title: Location Hub accessible via Composer
item.description:
Location Hub accessible via Composer — Manage physical stores and live events in one conversation â Ask Composer to create stores, link proximity segments, and fix missing Shopify POS links, with confirmation before every change.
(Published 2026-11-10)

item.title: Personalized Content in Flows
item.description:
Personalized Content in Flows — Match every flow text to each shopper's engagement â Use AI to adapt tone and product names in SMS and RCS messages, with automatic A/B tests against your original copy.
(Published 2026-11-09)

item.title: Up to 100 Accounts to 1 Parent account
item.description:
Up to 100 Accounts to 1 Parent account — Consolidate more subsidiaries and regions under one parent account â Link up to 100 accounts in an account family, up from 34, with unified billing and usage tracking.
(Published 2026-11-09)

item.title: Version History in Flows
item.description:
Version History in Flows — Edit live flows with a safety net â Restore any earlier version, see who changed what, and copy versions into drafts, including changes made by Composer.
(Published 2026-11-09)

item.title: Calendly connector in Composer
item.description:
Calendly connector in Composer — Composer now connects to Calendly. See your event types, meetings and availability in the same conversation. Check how many slots are open this week, or create a campaign inviting VIP customers to book a styling session, all without leaving Composer.
(Published 2026-11-06)

item.title: Webflow connector in Composer
item.description:
Webflow connector in Composer — Composer now connects to Webflow, available to every Klaviyo account. Pull in your site and CMS content and act on it in the same conversation. Turn a launch page into an announcement email, or add a new collection to your CMS and draft its campaign, all without leaving Composer.
(Published 2026-11-06)

item.title: Amplitude connector in Composer
item.description:
Amplitude connector in Composer — Composer now connects to Amplitude. Read your product analytics, charts and dashboards in the same conversation. Find where your checkout funnel loses the most people and get a flow built to win them back, all without leaving Composer.
(Published 2026-11-06)

item.title: Supermetrics connector in Composer
item.description:
Supermetrics connector in Composer — Composer now works with Supermetrics. Connect it to bring ad results from across your platforms into Composer, so the campaigns it plans and the recommendations it makes reflect your full marketing picture.
(Published 2026-11-06)

item.title: Notion connector in Composer
item.description:
Notion connector in Composer — Composer now connects to Notion. Search, read and update your pages and databases in the same conversation. Build a campaign from the actual Q4 brief rather than a pasted summary, or add a recap of last monthâs email and SMS results to your team wiki, all without leaving Composer.
(Published 2026-11-06)

item.title: Gorgias connector in Composer
item.description:
Gorgias connector in Composer — Composer now connects to Gorgias. Search tickets, macros and your help center, and update tickets, all in the same conversation. Find out what customers are complaining about this week and turn it into a win back flow, or pull the most common sizing questions into a fit guide email, all without leaving Composer.
(Published 2026-11-06)

item.title: Airtable connector in Composer
item.description:
Airtable connector in Composer — Composer now connects to Airtable. Read and edit your bases, tables and records in the same conversation. Draft campaigns for everything launching this month on your promo calendar, then mark each record as scheduled and add the campaign link, all without leaving Composer.
(Published 2026-11-06)

item.title: Wix connector in Composer
item.description:
Wix connector in Composer — Composer now connects to Wix. Pull in your site and CMS content and act on it in the same conversation. Check the current promo on your site and build a campaign to match, or draft a blog post announcing your holiday collection, all without leaving Composer.
(Published 2026-11-06)

item.title: Slide decks in Composer
item.description:
Slide decks in Composer — Take Composer presentations straight into your next meeting â Present, share, or download decks as PDF, editable PowerPoint, or HTML files.
(Published 2026-11-06)

item.title: Personalize flow messages with event data
item.description:
Personalize flow messages with event data, no code needed â Show or hide email blocks and add dynamic content using trigger event properties from any integration.
(Published 2026-11-06)

item.title: Forms in Composer
item.description:
Forms in Composer — Grow your list with less manual form building â Describe a new sign-up form or request copy, design, targeting, and trigger changes in Composer, then review desktop and mobile previews.
(Published 2026-11-06)

item.title: Folders in Campaigns
item.description:
Folders in Campaigns — Keep long campaign lists easy to navigate â Create nested folders, bulk move campaigns, and search or filter across every folder without changing how anything sends.
(Published 2026-11-06)

item.title: Shareable preview links for emails
item.description:
Shareable preview links for emails — Get email sign-off from anyone without a Klaviyo login â Share a live preview link with up to 10 reviewers to approve campaign and flow emails before they send.
(Published 2026-11-06)

item.title: CX Score in Customer Agent & Helpdesk
item.description:
CX Score in Customer Agent & Helpdesk — Measure service quality across every support conversation without waiting on surveys â View AI-estimated CX scores for Customer Agent and human replies next to CSAT in Helpdesk and Customer Agent analytics.
(Published 2026-11-05)

item.title: Reminders in Composer
item.description:
Reminders in Composer — Pick up right where you left off. Schedule a reminder in Composer and it comes back to the same conversation with a nudge, a draft, a proposal or a report.
(Published 2026-11-04)

item.title: Klaviyo and OpenTable integration enhancements
item.description:
Klaviyo and OpenTable integration enhancements — Reach guests the moment their plans change. Klaviyoâs OpenTable integration now syncs reservation updates as they happen, so you can follow up when a guest books, cancels or doesnât show up. Connect your POS to OpenTable to add check totals and orders to profiles too.
(Published 2026-11-04)

item.title: Live connector data in Composer artifacts
item.description:
Live connector data in Composer artifacts — Keep dashboards current when you reopen them â Ask Composer to build artifacts with live data from your connected apps.
(Published 2026-11-04)

item.title: Campaign A/B testing in Composer
item.description:
Campaign A/B testing in Composer — Test every campaign without the extra setup. Composer now builds email and SMS A/B tests along with your campaign, from subject lines and sender names to content, design and SMS copy.
(Published 2026-11-04)

item.title: Conversation sharing in Composer
item.description:
Conversation sharing in Composer — Give teammates the full context behind Composer's work â Share a conversation with workspace members so they can read your requests, Composer's responses, and its references.
(Published 2026-11-04)

item.title: K:Service Practitioner Certificate
item.description:
K:Service Practitioner Certificate — Show off your Klaviyo Service expertise with a recognized credential â Earn the K:Service Practitioner Certificate in Klaviyo Academy after completing the K:Service Practitioner program.
(Published 2026-11-04)

item.title: Downloadable files from Composer artifacts
item.description:
Downloadable files from Composer artifacts — Bring reports and slides to your next meeting â Ask Composer for a dashboard PDF, site or a downloadable PowerPoint deck.
(Published 2026-11-03)

item.title: Manage Email Tracking Consent on Preference Pages
item.description:
Manage Email Tracking Consent on Preference Pages — Let recipients change email tracking consent anytime â Add a Tracking consent block to preference pages covering opens, clicks, or both, shown only in regions you choose.
(Published 2026-11-03)

item.title: Shopify edits in Composer
item.description:
Shopify edits in Composer — Update your store without leaving Klaviyo â Ask Composer to make changes in Shopify, from prices to discount codes.
(Published 2026-11-02)

item.title: Composer now connects with Asana
item.description:
Composer now connects with Asana — Go from brief to campaign without copying anything over â Connect Asana and Composer turns your briefs and calendar into Klaviyo campaigns and flows.
(Published 2026-11-02)

item.title: Source Attribution in Customer Agent
item.description:
Source Attribution in Customer Agent — Know which messages drive AI-assisted sales â View Customer Agent revenue by flow, campaign, and web chat conversation starter in Service Overview, then ask Composer to dig in.
(Published 2026-11-02)

item.title: Improved Auto-Reply Editor
item.description:
Improved Auto-Reply Editor — Capture richer data and more clicks from Instagram DMs â Preview conversations as you edit Social Auto-replies, collect date properties, and send links as buttons.
(Published 2026-11-02)

item.title: Send to Primary Device
item.description:
Send to Primary Device — Reduce push costs and repeat notifications â Send push messages only to each customer's most active device with a new toggle in campaign and flow builders.
(Published 2026-11-02)

item.title: Custom events from skills in Customer Agent
item.description:
Custom events from skills in Customer Agent — Add a Send event step to a skill to write a custom event to a customerâs profile timeline. Pick the metric, then fill each property from the agentâs response, a fixed value, or profile data. Works for authenticated customers.
(Published 2026-10-30)

item.title: Runneth connector in Composer
item.description:
Runneth connector in Composer — Bring your best ad creative into email and SMS. Install the Runneth connector, Motionâs creative strategy agent, and ask about your brandâs ads in the same conversation where Composer builds your marketing.
(Published 2026-10-30)

item.title: Sync up to 6 objects with the SFDC integration
item.description:
Sync up to 6 objects with the SFDC integration — Bring more Salesforce data into Klaviyo â Sync up to 6 Salesforce objects instead of 3 to segment and personalize with fuller customer context.
(Published 2026-10-30)

item.title: Assignment Notification Emails in Helpdesk
item.description:
Assignment Notification Emails in Helpdesk — Catch new ticket assignments right away, even outside the helpdesk â Turn on assignment emails in Helpdesk settings to get notified each time a ticket is assigned to you.
(Published 2026-10-30)

item.title: Omnichannel Campaigns in Composer
item.description:
Omnichannel Campaigns in Composer — Composer can now create omnichannel campaigns in the new Composer experience. The previous version supported this, but the new Composer rolled out with single-channel campaigns only, and customers have been asking for it back.
(Published 2026-10-29)

item.title: Take action from a comment thread with Composer
item.description:
Take action from a comment thread with Composer — Turn feedback into edits faster. Send a comment thread from the email editor or forms designer to Composer, and it drafts the requested changes or summarizes the thread.
(Published 2026-10-29)

item.title: Simpler usage meter in Composer
item.description:
Simpler usage meter in Composer — One bar shows how much you've used and when it resets, with a warning at 85%. Billing usage reports now include Composer credits.
(Published 2026-10-29)

item.title: Private or shared skills in Composer
item.description:
Private or shared skills in Composer — When you create a skill, choose whether to keep it private or share it with your team.
(Published 2026-10-29)

item.title: Enhanced Capabilities - HTML Content Blocks
item.description:
Enhanced Capabilities - HTML Content Blocks — Design fully branded onsite content without template limits â Add custom HTML and CSS to content blocks for Customer Hub and your site, with real-time preview and unsupported-code warnings.
(Published 2026-10-29)

item.title: WhatsApp Channel Affinity
item.description:
WhatsApp Channel Affinity — Reach WhatsApp-first shoppers on the channel they prefer â Build segments using WhatsApp channel affinity rankings alongside email, SMS, and push predictions.
(Published 2026-10-29)

item.title: Brand styles from website in Composer
item.description:
Brand styles from website in Composer — Composer can now pull your brand's visual style from your website, including colors, typography and button styles, and apply it to the content it builds. Share your site, review the palette and styles Composer suggests, approve them, then ask for a sample email in the new look.
(Published 2026-10-28)

item.title: Meta Ads connector in Composer
item.description:
Meta Ads connector in Composer — Composer now connects to Meta Ads. Marketers can ask how their Facebook and Instagram ads are performing and get answers that combine Meta Ads data with Klaviyo customer data, then turn what they learn into Klaviyo campaigns. The connector is read-only: it reads ad accounts, campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, budgets, statuses and performance, but doesn't change targeting, budgets or ads. Changes still happen in Meta Ads Manager.
(Published 2026-10-28)

item.title: Floating Composer bar
item.description:
Floating Composer bar — Ask Composer from anywhere in Klaviyo. Its input box follows you from page to page, with prompts that fit where you are and keep open and hide controls.
(Published 2026-10-28)

item.title: Next-step suggestions in Composer
item.description:
Next-step suggestions in Composer — Keep the work moving. The message box cycles through the next steps Composer suggested in its latest reply, so you can pick one without retyping it.
(Published 2026-10-28)

item.title: Location Hub
item.description:
Location Hub — Reach customers near every location in a few clicks â Add stores and live events to build proximity segments and track in-store revenue with Shopify POS.
(Published 2026-10-28)

item.title: Artifacts in Composer
item.description:
Artifacts in Composer — Anything Composer makes can become an artifact: a live web page with its own link, built from a single ask.
(Published 2026-10-28)

item.title: Spam to Intake Rules in Helpdesk
item.description:
Spam to Intake Rules in Helpdesk — Decide what counts as spam in your support queue â Create a custom intake rule when you mark a message as spam so Helpdesk sorts similar future messages correctly.
(Published 2026-10-28)

item.title: Live Product Experts in Composer
item.description:
Live Product Experts in Composer — Get answers and live help without repeating yourself â Click Support to ask Composer, then connect with a Product Expert in the same chat with context carried over.
(Published 2026-10-28)

item.title: Smart Translations for Consent Pages
item.description:
Smart Translations for Consent Pages — Give subscribers a localized experience from sign-up onward â Translate hosted subscribe, unsubscribe, and preferences pages plus double opt-in emails into multiple languages with Smart Translations.
(Published 2026-10-28)

item.title: Organized Chat History for Composer
item.description:
Organized Chat History for Composer — Chats are grouped by date with unread chats at the top, and history opens inside the Composer panel.
(Published 2026-10-27)
